posts.author: satilte
posts.body:
Ocean Roses
Ocean Roses
is a short RPG adventure following Pavel, a soldier in the country of Vydrin, fighting to protect Castle Mytrogod from invading forces. For the first act, he is joined by Sonya, an archer, and is later joined by the Prince, Maksim Georgiev.
This game uses a CTB Battle System, a unique battle formula, and multiple waves of enemies in special encounters. Additionally, it borrows a campfire system from Souls-like games, making traversing the castle and finding loot/accessories simple and accessible.
This game was made for the
RPGMAKER 2025 Game Jam
, borrowing elements from another game I was workshopping (mainly, the world and some game design elements). It's my first published game after working on some other unreleased projects, and I feel I learned a lot, coding and mapping-wise, as well as letting me ramble through characters.
I also composed the entirety of the game's soundtrack and ambience, which was fun. I really like the battle themes I composed. I only wish I had more time to make more variations and alternative tracks. I composed the main theme really early into the jam, and based a large portion of the other songs on it due to time constraints.
Fun fact: Nearly the entirety of the soundtrack is in odd time signatures, which I think is cool. I think the only explicit 4/4 song is played in the library, which uses tuplets.
Content warning
Contains political discussions from some characters (pro-/anti-monarchical, stereotyping, art), perverse intellectualism, allusions to violence, violence, passing references to alcohol, explicit references to cannibalism, pregnancy, references to infant mortality, references to debauchery, mild bad language
